bull.probability_evidence: Quality at multi-year highs (TTM ROIC 57.6%, operating margin 28.1% rising +8.0pp/5y, FCF margin 36.4%) with every multiple 33-44% below peer median and below the stock's own 5y minimum (factsheet RA/valuation); agentic AI across Forma/Fusion/Flow and the Eaton Workbench 360 partnership (PRNewswire/BusinessWire 2026-09-09/09-10/09-15) support the bull thesis that AI extends rather than erodes the moat, and buybacks (-1.62% shares YoY) compound per-share value (evaluation bull case; note §5).

target_band.cite: Half-spread of the fact sheet's bull-case valuation anchors (DCF 186.93 vs EV/Revenue 405.65; half-spread 109.36) relative to the $300 target = 36.5%, which exceeds the inputs file's blended residual volatility (research/ADSK/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended = 32.9%); capped at that measured ceiling per the house rule that target_band must not exceed residual volatility.

base.probability_evidence: Guidance reset at the 2026-08-28 Q2 FY2027 print (beat on revenue and EPS, but Q3/FY guidance fell short of Street expectations, stock fell ~4%, Barrons https://www.barrons.com/articles/autodesk-earnings-stock-price-a695556f) signals growth converging toward the fact sheet's mechanical base fair value of 219.04 rather than the 20.6% year-1 growth the price implied, cushioned by ongoing buybacks (-1.62% shares YoY, factsheet ST) and net-cash balance sheet.

target_band.cite: Half-spread of the fact sheet's base-case valuation anchors (DCF 144.84 vs EV/Revenue 367.44; half-spread 111.30) relative to the $225 target = 49.5%, which exceeds the inputs file's blended residual volatility (research/ADSK/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended = 32.9%); capped at that measured ceiling per the house rule that target_band must not exceed residual volatility.

bear.probability_evidence: The 10-K concedes 'limited barriers to entry' and names Adobe, Bentley, Dassault Systèmes and PTC as AI-native competitors capable of eroding seat-based pricing (SEC 10-K, cited in note §2); momentum is already weak (12-month -27.7%, -43.5pp vs SPY, 50-day MA below 200-day MA, factsheet Price section), consistent with the market re-anchoring on the lower DCF value rather than EV/Revenue.

target_band.cite: Half-spread of the fact sheet's bear-case valuation anchors (DCF 50.05 vs EV/Revenue 275.35; half-spread 112.65) relative to the $165 target = 68.3%, which exceeds the inputs file's blended residual volatility (research/ADSK/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended = 32.9%); capped at that measured ceiling per the house rule that target_band must not exceed residual volatility.
